subject: BrightCart sandbox samples — MAP, acceptance gates, and handback cadence
messages:
From: Albert Tran <albert.tran@brightcart.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot MAP + sample exchange (BrightCart trial)

Hi Jonas / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. BrightCart is excited to run the pilot. To keep things tidy for procurement, legal, and our data team, can we confirm a short mutual action plan for exchanging the evaluation collateral (probe cases + promptpack) and the acceptance / handback schedule?

High level asks from our side:
- We need an ephemeral sandbox with token-limited access for 8 data scientists.
- BrightCart will deliver a 2k-row probe list (CSV) and a set of canonical prompts (promptpack).
- Acceptance criteria: 10% uplift on intent classification F1 vs our baseline in the sandbox (runbook to be provided).
- After the 6-week pilot window, all BrightCart raw probe rows must be deleted by both parties (no retention beyond agreed window).

Can Redwood provide a suggested MAP (milestones + owners) and a handback cadence? Also please confirm any constraints on derivative use / logging while the probe is live.

Appreciate a quick sketch we can attach to the PO.

—Albert
Albert Tran
Head of Data Science | BrightCart
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Albert Tran <albert.tran@brightcart.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + sample exchange (BrightCart trial)

Albert —

Thanks — this is straightforward and aligned with our standard pilot flows. Attached is a one-page MAP draft (redwood-MAP-draft-20260528.docx) and a short checklist for the sandboxing/handback steps. TL;DR below:

Proposed MAP (milestones & owners):
1) Kickoff & asset drop (Week 0) — BrightCart delivers probe CSV + promptpack to the secure intake bucket (Albert).
2) Ingest & staging (Days 1–3) — Redwood verifies schema, creates ephemeral sandbox, issues scoped API tokens (Jonas).
3) Baseline run & instrumentation (Week 1) — BrightCart runs baseline in their staging; Redwood enables per-route token-level logging for debugging only (Marissa).
4) Evaluation window (Weeks 2–7) — Active runs, weekly syncs, metric collection (joint ownership).
5) Acceptance review (Week 8) — Evaluate against F1 gate and transfer acceptance report (BrightCart).
6) Handback & destruction (Within 72h of close) — Both parties confirm deletion and provide checksum of deletions (Albert/Jonas).

Usage constraints / logging:
- Redwood will provide ephemeral tokens that expire after the pilot plus a single 7-day grace period for incident triage.
- We will persist only aggregated evaluation metrics by default; we can enable request/response logging for 3-day windows on request but those logs are treated as restricted and require explicit approval and a retention timestamp (Marissa will own approvals).
- No derivative training on BrightCart raw rows during the pilot or for 6 months after (unless a separate agreement is signed).

Next steps: if that MAP looks good I can drop a DocuSign-ready SOW and we can provision the sandbox Monday.

Jonas Weber
Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Albert Tran <albert.tran@brightcart.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@brightcart.com>
Date: 2026-05-31T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + sample exchange (BrightCart trial)

Albert / team —

Couple of clarifications from an ops / compliance angle so the intake and handback are frictionless:

1) Intake format: CSV columns required: id, user_utterance, label, timestamp, metadata_json (if present). Please keep PII out of the probe rows — hashed ids ok.
2) Sandbox tokens: we create per-user API tokens (max 8). Tokens will be scoped to the sandbox model route only and will show up in the Console under the pilot project; BrightCart can request rotation at any time.
3) Retention & logs:
   - Aggregated metrics retained for 12 months (we use them to monitor regressions across pilots).
   - Raw request/response logs (when enabled) will be retained for up to 30 days, then purged. Permanent storage of raw rows is not allowed.
4) Handback proof: We will produce a deletion manifest and a SHA256 checksum of the original CSV (both parties sign off). If BrightCart prefers a joint purge run (both parties issue deletion) we can schedule it in the MAP.

Attachment: BrightCart_probe_list_v1.csv (sample manifest) — Albert, drop the full CSV to the secure intake link in the MAP draft and flag when uploaded.

I'll be the approvals contact for any log access beyond the default.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Onboarding | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Albert Tran <albert.tran@brightcart.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-03T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + sample exchange (BrightCart trial)

Albert / Sophie —

This plan works for Legal/Procurement on our side. A couple of small asks before SOW:
- Add the acceptance gate metric definition to the MAP (how F1 is computed, dataset splits).
- Confirm the on-paper statement that BrightCart prohibits Redwood from retaining raw probe rows for training or model evaluation beyond the pilot period (we'll include a 6-month no-derivatives clause as discussed).

If you can confirm those two items I will queue the SOW and a standard pilot SOW — Jonas, please queue DocuSign and let Procurement know the 6-week timeline.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Counsel — Redwood Inference
